title: Fix Canvas Frozen After Commit 435
description: Canvas frozen, no interaction after commit 5957bf92a (message 435). Analyze diff and restore pointer/event handling.
summary: Commit 435 stacked a text overlay canvas above the WebGPU board; pointer listeners are only on the lower canvas, so if the overlay took hits the board felt frozen. Fixed with pointer-events-none on the stack wrapper, pointer-events-auto on the GPU canvas, inline pointer-events none on the overlay, merging attachTextOverlayCanvas into the same useLayoutEffect as BoardRenderer construction, and a vitest asserting the pass-through classes.
